summary: 最終outcomeとは別にtrajectory(tool call列、権限操作、探索量、artifact)をsample監査し、outcome/process/artifact/efficiencyの別軸で評価して危険な途中操作や無駄な探索を検出する

evidence.summary: METR: transcript監査によりscoring bug、test改変、reference取得を検出(scoreだけでは不可視)。
Anthropic: 「You won't know if your graders are working well unless you read the transcripts」。outcomeをgradeしつつtrace監査を常設。
OpenAI Skill eval guidance(R9, local research-foundationsで採用済): outcome, process, artifacts, efficiencyの別軸check。

ai-development-improvement (org-private, reputation unknown): read references/evaluation-policy.md: the 'Evaluation unit' section lists outcome, trajectory, artifacts, efficiency and guardrails as separate capture axes and defines outcome as the final state/artifact rather than the agent's completion claim; record_evaluation.py persists the run artifacts that make trajectory review possible.

applies_when: Agent trace/transcriptを保存できる(Claude Code session log, Codex log)
権限操作や外部副作用を伴うtask
not_applicable_when: traceが保存されない環境(先にobservabilityを整備)

expected_effect.primary: 最終結果だけでは見えない危険操作・無駄探索・oracle攻略を検出する

cost: 低〜中: sample監査の運用時間
known_failure_modes: aggregate scoreだけで採用判断(local card)
手順を厳密にgradeして別解を落とす(Anthropic; process監査はoutcome graderと分ける)

existing_asset.confirmed_by: read references/evaluation-policy.md: the 'Evaluation unit' section lists outcome, trajectory, artifacts, efficiency and guardrails as separate capture axes and defines outcome as the final state/artifact rather than the agent's completion claim; record_evaluation.py persists the run artifacts that make trajectory review possible.
matched_on: outcome, trajectory, artifact and efficiency captured as separate axes
outcome defined against the completion claim
trajectory enumerated as commands, tool calls, skipped/required steps, time, tokens and retries

evidence: org-private shared plugin in the TechLog shared checkout; not published, so there is no public track record to assess

alternates.why_not_primary: Its skill-failure-attribution agent reads the transcript and directs the reviewer at the trajectory rather than only the final output, but it runs per failed eval case rather than as a standing sample audit.
